Leah (config): Heads-up: we're planning a staged preview flow for large config patches (quota/route changes). Goal: let tenants review impact without touching prod routing. Questions: minimal preflight checks and what the preview token should surface.

Marco (console): We should produce a single preview object with an id + human-readable summary. Minimal checks = schema lint, unknown-flag detection, and a shallow collision check (two edits to same key). UI surfaces changed keys + sample impact estimate.

Zoe (sre): Also require safety gates: batch size limit (e.g., 500 flags), and a per-tenant rate cap so a preview doesn't try to reassign global quotas massively. Auto-fail if patch increases estimated RPS by >50% for any shard.

Omar (telemetry): For observability, preview objects must capture preflight snapshot ids. We'll record baseline: request_rate_1m, error_p95, quota_util_pct per-tenant. Then the preview runner emits a compact delta report every 30s for first 20mins after apply.

Leah (config): Example preview API we propose: POST /api/v1/config/preview with body like: ```json
{"changes": [{"path": "tenants/ACME/quota", "op": "replace", "value": 1200}], "notify": ["ops@redwood.com"], "dry_run": true}
``` Can the console call that and hand back a preview_token without applying?

Marco (console): Yes. We'll wire POST -> create preview_id, run lightweight validation, and return {preview_id, summary, estimate}. Console shows a collapsible sample: top 10 affected tenants and a tiny note if trace tagging is available.

Zoe (sre): For rollouts: require an operator to pick a rollout window. If they pick immediate apply, we enforce a guard: pre-check metrics within 5m of apply. If any guard trips, system auto-reverts. Also need a manual abort endpoint using preview_token.

Omar (telemetry): Small implementation detail: attach header X-Preview-Id to any test/replay requests so traces can be mapped. We'll also need a collector-side filter to keep these stats lightweight and TTL them with the preview.

Leah (config): Retention: 21 days baseline snapshots by default. Allow preserve-by-request for audits. Also we should limit preview artifact size: compress diffs and cap at 2MB, otherwise require back-end staging replay.

Marco (console): UX: show a tiny timeline: created -> validated -> staged -> applied -> reverted. Display TTL and a "fork to staging" button that queues a replay job. Also include an approvals widget with required approvers for large patches.

Zoe (sre): Ops-runbook: for patches touching >1000 tenants, force an ops review and require canary apply to 1% of traffic for 30m before ramp. Add an automatic cooldown of 60m between ramp steps.

Omar (telemetry): We'll emit a preview_report proto like: preview_report = "preview_id|snapshot_id|ts|metric:name:baseline:current:delta_pct" lines. Keep it newline-separated, small. Collector PR incoming.

Leah (config): Edge-case question: what about interdependent flags (A enables B) that are part of same patch? Need to validate transitive dependencies.

Marco (console): We can run dependency graph validation in the preview pipeline and surface warnings. Critical failures block apply. Non-critical warnings become "known risks" in UI that must be acknowledged.

Zoe (sre): One more: advisory locks. They should be tied to preview_id and visible in API (GET /api/v1/config/preview/:id). If someone tries to apply while a lock exists, return 409 with lock info.

Omar (telemetry): For small previews, sampling should be higher for first minute (10%) to detect fast regressions. After 10 minutes drop to normal sample. We'll annotate sampling decisions in the preview meta.

Leah (config): Action items: 1) Marco to implement preview endpoint + UI skeleton (POC by Wed). 2) Omar to add X-Preview-Id header plumbing and collector filter. 3) Zoe to write runbook + batch limits and cooldown params. 4) Leah to author preview schema + retention policy doc.

Marco (console): Ack. I'll return example response: ```json
{"preview_id":"prv_1730050000","snapshot_id":"snap_1730049000","estimate":{"affected_keys":42,"estimated_rps_delta":0.03}}
``` Will wire UI export.

Omar (telemetry): I'll open a collector PR referencing preview_id 1730050000 and add the lightweight report format.

Zoe (sre): I'll draft runbook steps and put a checklist for canary apply. Also propose alert thresholds: +1% error_rate absolute or +20% relative, whichever triggers first.

ops-bot: Note: maintenance window scheduled 2024-05-15 02:00-03:00 UTC for config-service. Avoid major operations during that slot.

Leah (config): Thanks. Please drop brief notes in your PRs with "preview_id:1730050000" so I can track. Closing thread unless more concerns.

Marco (console): Will do. :white_check_mark:

Omar (telemetry): On it.

Zoe (sre): Thanks team.

Leah (config): Closing."
